**Publish gate report: Assam Breakfast product page**

**Going out:** Product page copy for Assam Breakfast, Pebblebrook Tea Co. website.

**Claims check**
| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "malty, full-bodied black tea that stands up to milk" | Product/flavour fact, fine as written |
| "boosts your immunity through winter" | **Health claim, never allowed (policy §3).** Remove. |
| "Certified organic by the Soil Association" | On policy list, exact wording, certificate renewed 2026. Fine. |
| "100g tin, makes around 40 cups" | Tin size and cup count are product facts, fine. |

**Regulated claims:** The immunity line is the only problem. "Boosts immunity" is a health claim that needs authorised wording and evidence, and the policy bans health claims of any kind. No safer health-flavoured rewrite exists, so the line goes. Winter appeal can stay as a warm, true idea ("a cup for a cold afternoon").

**House style:** No banned words, UK spelling, tone is plain. Fine once the health claim is gone. Score about 90.

**Disclosure:** Own-brand product page, no partnership, affiliate link, or AI-labelling trigger. Pass.

**Fixed (suggested rewrite, not yet approved):**
> Assam Breakfast. A malty, full-bodied black tea that stands up to milk, and a good one for a cold winter morning. Certified organic by the Soil Association. 100g tin, makes around 40 cups.

**Needs a decision:** Confirm you're happy with the rewritten winter line, or cut it for the shorter version without it.

**Approver:** Sam (marketing lead). I haven't recorded any approval, and nothing should be published until Sam says yes to the exact final text above. The original draft as written should not go out.
